review_mode: Static source and existing artificial CPU receipt reads only; no candidate invocation, real archive action, original telemetry parse, process inspection, source edit or Git mutation.

confirmed: Production part limit is exactly 67108864 bytes. Only canonical packed originals strictly larger than this limit are selected; equal-size and smaller originals remain in the base inventory.

Pinned A13 split_archive writes exclusive parts, checks each part size/hash and verifies ordered concatenation SHA/size against the complete packed original. Overlay additionally records contiguous offsets and verifies each part byte count/hash.

Input to splitting is the existing canonical packed byte stream. No gzip decode, decompression, recompression, original deletion or scientific replay occurs. Restore uses exclusive output and verifies every part followed by complete packed SHA/size.

The original inventory exact SHA is required; canonical full path membership must equal that inventory, selected original packed SHA/size must match its entry, and original file signatures plus inventory bytes remain unchanged across splitting and final sealing.

Git ignore patterns are slash-anchored literal escaped paths for selected oversized originals only. Already tracked oversized originals are rejected. Existing and final ignored sets over the complete original file list differ only by the selected paths.

A pending manifest with passed=false exists before .gitignore is created. Final passed=true manifest is created only after ignore and original membership/stat checks. The post-ignore failure fixture confirms no final success manifest appears on failure; originals and partial evidence remain.

Actual collector completion is required separately: its matching closed-mode argv/source, actual waited rc0, unchanged source receipt, correct interval arithmetic and saved coordinator/child absence must be verified before overlay work. Artificial CPU PASS is not used as the real collector wait.
limits: No real collector completion, current saved-process absence, real inventory integrity or actual overlay success was verified by this review.
Decoded raw-byte proof remains the original immutable v1 inventory proof; this operation verifies packed-byte representation and deliberately does not repeat decompression or science.

blockers.finding: validate_row permits any nonempty string kind. Selection.kind_counts retains the complete kind as a result key. main's oversized-output fallback clears selected records and first-fault/callback bodies but retains kind_counts, then writes the second serialization without checking its length. A synthetic valid motion row with an unselected kind slightly larger than 2MiB but below the 8MiB line limit can therefore still produce a final result larger than the fixed 2MiB output cap.
blockers.minimum_fix: Preserve v1 and its real CPU result. In a new version, ensure oversized-output fallback uses a fixed bounded failure receipt or removes/hashes every potentially unbounded field, then check the final serialized size before writing. Add a main-level artificial oversized-kind fixture. Do not loosen parsing, source, epoch or scientific predicates.

otherwise_confirmed: Pending admitted=false/null SHA spec refuses raw consumption. Actual admission requires exactly the two fixed paths, original byte sizes, one canonical closed inventory reference and each original SHA/byte/stability/decoded-proof entry. It does not require the original scientific activity to have passed.

Seven interpretation sources must equal current bytes and old Git 1fa55bc56d5bb9e230d4b397f962d83b1604b278; the consumer separately must equal its own exact new execution HEAD. It imports no producer/scientific implementation as an oracle.

Whole inputs are streamed once with strict duplicate/nonfinite/overflow JSON validation. Bad rows retain FAIL and prevent NOT_RECORDED while remaining bytes continue to be hashed unless a declared limit/deadline stops the scan.

First fault is selected by original physical line order, not wall-time sorting. The fixed-window first/last buckets and original records preserve robot/reason/source fields without constructing a causal queue or changing old FAIL.

Source and input stat/byte binding checks are repeated after reading. Partial/over-budget parsing is FAIL and descriptive, never mathematical/native qualification or proof that no unrecorded fault existed.
